estilo: Semi-realistic 2D cartoon illustration in a polished vector style: clean bold outlines, soft cel shading, expressive detailed human characters with realistic proportions and emotional faces, richly detailed environments with depth, cinematic lighting, saturated but harmonious palette with teal, orange and warm skin tones, vertical 9:16 composition with the main subject centered in the middle 60% of the frame (top and bottom left calmer for text). Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no captions anywhere in the image.
host: The channel host: a young Latino man around 25, short dark hair with a slight fade, warm brown eyes, friendly confident smile, athletic muscular build, plain black sleeveless tank top. Keep exactly the same face, hair and outfit as the reference image.

tomas.prompt: Medium close-up of the host in a modern gym at dawn, looking straight at the camera with a skeptical smile, one hand raised in a 'stop' gesture, warm orange sunrise light through windows, teal shadows, dumbbell racks blurred behind.

The host mid-dumbbell curl in the gym, flexed arm, a glowing orange paper order (an envelope-like slip with no writing) floating up from his arm and flying away, sparks of orange light, dynamic low angle.

Anatomical cutaway of a muscular arm made translucent, inside the muscle a tiny glowing factory with conveyor belts standing still, dim lights, sleeping little workers, teal and orange glow, dark background, centered vertical composition.

The same translucent muscular arm cutaway, now the tiny factory is busy: little workers adding bright orange glowing threads that thicken the muscle fibers, conveyor belts moving, through a window behind it a moon and sunset sky suggest time passing, warm glow, vertical composition.

The host at a kitchen table at night between two glowing things: on the left a plate with grilled chicken, eggs and rice glowing softly orange, on the right a cozy bed with a glowing teal crescent moon above it; he points at the plate with one hand and at the bed with the other, smiling, warm and teal lighting.

Dark bedroom at 2 a.m., the host lying awake in bed staring at his phone, face lit by the cold blue screen, tired eyes with dark circles, alarm clock glow without numbers on the nightstand, moody blue shadows.

The tiny glowing factory inside a floating bubble: all its lights are off, a big red padlock closes the factory door, unopened orange boxes piled up outside, dark gloomy mood with a faint red glow, vertical composition.

Bright morning bedroom, the host sitting up in bed stretching his arms with a big rested smile, golden sunlight through the window, a plate with eggs and chicken on the nightstand, warm cheerful palette.
The tiny factory in a floating bubble fully lit and busy, workers cheering, and next to it a bigger glowing muscular arm, golden orange and teal light, triumphant happy mood, vertical composition.

Medium close-up of the host in the gym smiling confidently at the camera, pointing his index finger downward toward the bottom of the screen, warm orange light, teal gym background softly blurred, friendly invitation pose.
